title: Meridian Trust Bank Pricing Disclosure for Northgate Credit Cards
content:
Meridian Trust Bank discloses the following pricing for each Northgate Credit Cards product at account opening.

## Disclosure table

| Card product | Annual card fee while the linked membership is paid | Standard variable purchase APR | Foreign transaction fee (purchases in a foreign currency) | Promotional deferred-interest months on qualifying Northgate purchases | Smallest single Northgate purchase that qualifies for promotional financing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | $0.00 | 29.99% | 0% | 6 | $299.00 |
| Northgate Business Store Card | $0.00 | 29.99% | 0% | 0 (none) | $0.00 (no promotional financing) |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | $0.00 | 20.49% | 0% | 0 (none) | $0.00 (no promotional financing) |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | $0.00 | 20.49% | 0% | 0 (none) | $0.00 (no promotional financing) |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | $0.00 | 20.49% | 0% | 0 (none) | $0.00 (no promotional financing) |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | $0.00 | 20.49% | 0% | 0 (none) | $0.00 (no promotional financing) |

A promotional figure of 0 months means the product offers no promotional financing.

## Notes to the disclosure

- **Annual fee.** No product charges an annual card fee while the linked membership is paid.
- **APR.** The two store cards carry a standard variable purchase APR of 29.99%; the four Rewards Visa products carry 20.49%.
- **Foreign transactions.** No product charges a fee on purchases made in a foreign currency.
- **Promotional financing.** Only the Northgate Store Card offers it: 6 months of deferred interest on a single Northgate purchase of at least $299.00.

## Promotional financing boundary (hypothetical purchases on a Northgate Store Card)

| Single Northgate purchase | Qualifies for the 6-month promotional financing |
|---|---|
| $299.00 | Yes (at least $299.00) |
| $298.99 | No (below $299.00) |
| $450.00 | Yes |
